seo.libraryTitle: Stories in {lang} by level, with translation
seo.libraryDescription: Short, funny stories in {lang}, from beginner to advanced, with an English translation. Read them here and play them free in the app, with audio and questions.
seo.libraryIntro: You learn a language fastest from stories you almost fully understand. Every story here is short, a little silly, and keeps repeating the same few words, so they stick by themselves. Pick your level and start.
seo.levelDescription: {count} short stories in {lang} at level {level}, with translation and the key words. Read them here, play them free in the app.

levelAbout.A1: A1 is the very beginning. Short sentences in the present tense about things you see every day: food, the neighbours, the supermarket. You need to know nothing yet.
levelAbout.A2: At A2 you tell what happened and what you want. Sentences get longer, a past tense appears, and the stories are about work, housing and appointments.
levelAbout.B1: At B1 you get by in almost any everyday situation. The stories have more twists, subordinate clauses and words for feelings and opinions.
levelAbout.B2: At B2 you follow a conversation about almost anything. The stories are longer, faster and full of expressions you hear in real life.
